opportunities.name: Wall Isolated Motion
opportunities.objective: Measure isolated Q accuracy after W against targets beside a minion.
opportunities.mechanic: Q doubles damage only when hitting one enemy. W removes MR and slows for five seconds; Cosmic follows Q magic to adjust the next blast, while Rylai tests retention beyond W. Riftmaker supports a living close-range sequence with E damage between isolated Q hits.
opportunities.requiredState: W crossed and Q hits exactly one unit with enough mana to continue.
opportunities.failure: Minions break isolation or proximity kills Karthus before ramp.
opportunities.test: Measure isolated Q accuracy after W against targets beside a minion; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Two enemies do not each receive isolated-double Q damage.

opportunities.name: Death Window Global Finish
opportunities.objective: Log full R completion and low-health damage inside the seven-second window.
opportunities.mechanic: P allows free spells for seven seconds after death; R needs a three-second channel. Shadowflame can enhance qualifying low-health Requiem magic damage, and Cryptbloom may reward an actual damage-tagged takedown. Blackfire tests damage persistence from E/Q before the R channel.
opportunities.requiredState: Record death time, R readiness, enemy health and last damage time; start R with three seconds remaining.
opportunities.failure: Waiting for low-health targets leaves insufficient passive time; First Strike may be unavailable.
opportunities.test: Log full R completion and low-health damage inside the seven-second window; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Death form is finite and does not permit unlimited free casts.

ruledOut.reason: P permits abilities after death, not ordinary attack-based on-hit farming.

unknowns: Item/rune triggers and Cryptbloom healing origin after death need live confirmation; First Strike is only counted when actually ready.

testPlan: Required state: W crossed and Q hits exactly one unit with enough mana to continue.
Measure isolated Q accuracy after W against targets beside a minion; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Minions break isolation or proximity kills Karthus before ramp.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Two enemies do not each receive isolated-double Q damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Cosmic Drive, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
